## ascii-equivalents-keys-are-lookalike-codepoints  (gotcha, verified)
parse.ts ASCII_EQUIVALENTS has keys that render identically but are distinct codepoints; never edit it by eye.

## build-runs-tsup-before-tsc  (invariant, verified)
Every package's build must be `tsup && tsc`; reversing it lets tsup's clean wipe the tsc-emitted .d.ts files.

- source/*/packages/*/package.json
- source/*/packages/*/tsup.config.ts
- source/core/tsconfig.base.json

## changed-projects-shared-ci-regex-rejects-hyphens  (gotcha, verified)
changed-projects treats only ci-<letters>.yml as shared CI, so a hyphenated ci-foo-bar.yml change selects no project.

- .github/actions/changed-projects/action.yml
- .github/workflows/ci-*.yml

## gt-worktree-setup-runs-sync-not-render  (gotcha, verified)
The .gt.yaml setup template runs `agtk sync` on every clone and `gt wt add`, so a new worktree can relock the ref:main stacks over the network.

- .gt.yaml
- .agentic-toolkit.lock.yaml

## release-previous-dist-tag-is-sticky-per-project  (gotcha, verified)
Release picks one dist-tag per project; if any package's registry latest is newer, the whole project publishes under `previous`.

- .github/workflows/release.yml

## workspace-deps-resolve-through-dist-only  (invariant, verified)
A @vipengele/* workspace dependency resolves only through its built dist/, so type-check, test and lydite must build dependencies first.

- source/*/packages/*/package.json
- source/core/turbo.json
- source/core/tsconfig.base.json
- .lydite/components.yml
